method: Independent manual relevance/contract audit plus executable counterexamples; not a replacement for full runtime/system release audit engine

axes.name: Purpose & decision fitness
axes.assessment: User scope/UDP matched; creation only, no full-R1 claim.

axes.name: Authority, pointers & state consistency
axes.assessment: Current state already directed fresh evidence; Q-3 mirrors that in inputs. One current pointer, no early feature completion.

axes.name: Schema, enums & version integrity
axes.assessment: Independent3 canonical profiles plus explicit provenance PASS; no canonical changes.

axes.name: Identity, deduplication & idempotency
axes.assessment: Exact IDs/bytes, no implicit dedupe; repeat/conflict probes; new workspace runtime pending.

axes.name: Temporal correctness & daily history
axes.assessment: Immutable timestamps/revisions, no refreshed capture or rewritten accepted history.

axes.name: Method/scope/source-route comparability
axes.assessment: No ResearchRun/SourceRoute/temporal comparison added; SCE stages retained.

axes.name: Sources, provenance & evidence traceability
axes.assessment: Explicit unknown/user/AI origin; no fabricated Source/Run/model/evidence.

axes.name: Sampling & measurement validity
axes.assessment: Synthetic samples not generalized to performance or real public data quality.

axes.name: Economics & effort validity
axes.assessment: Single bounded form, no new jobs/provider/editor infrastructure.

axes.name: Dependency/change propagation
axes.assessment: Changed AWR components/source map pinned; accepted code stays unchanged.

axes.name: Bootstrap, reuse & handoff
axes.assessment: Checkpoint design/required inputs verified; cross-process/native recovery gate pending.

axes.name: Configurability & extensibility
axes.assessment: Deterministic serialization and actual byte/hash oracle; new runtime pending.

axes.name: Crash, retry, concurrency & recovery
axes.assessment: Per-intent state isolation and truthful incomplete/UNKNOWN/save controls; new real UI pending.

axes.name: Security, path confinement & data safety
axes.assessment: Separate untrusted source copy/private payload; native guard gate pending; original4 blocker retained.

axes.name: Migrations & backward compatibility
axes.assessment: No schema migration; per-intent profile version fixed, future expansion reviewed.

axes.name: Portability & capability awareness
axes.assessment: Windows-only gates explicit, local fixture PASS is not native source security proof.

axes.name: Performance & long-term scalability
axes.assessment: Chunked input and separate versioned quotas/budgets; full throughput/large workload deferred.

axes.name: Diagnostics, observability & repairability
axes.assessment: Partial/resumable state table, no silent cleanup/new IDs or accepted-status guesses.

axes.name: Test quality & refactor resilience
axes.assessment: Ten independent adversarial/profile probes; future authoring per-criterion/native evidence pending.

axes.name: Release, manifest, docs & workbook integrity
axes.assessment: Planning review only, no release version/manifest/map changes or full acceptance.

axes.name: Use-case routing correctness & determinism
axes.assessment: UC19 registry3.2.0 development owner matches; routing untouched.

axes.name: Use-case boundaries, orthogonality & coverage
axes.assessment: Creation scope separated from editors/research; no new UC/provider contract.

axes.name: Workflow composition, transitions & closure
axes.assessment: Explicit prepare→publish→save/receipt and scoped closure; no pending state relabelled complete.

axes.name: DRY, canonical ownership & derived-view integrity
axes.assessment: Canonical schemas/producer/read contracts own semantics; new journal adapter only, not duplicate Bank truth.

axes.name: End-to-end action & evidence traceability
axes.assessment: Original card→issues→selected proposal→probe→guarded receipt and implementation task lineage.

axes.name: Architecture simplicity & complexity budget
axes.assessment: Compose current components with one own workspace/adapter/form; no general queue/research platform.
